fields.summary_ko.0: SpaceX (SPCX) receives Strong Buy ratings from Wall Street with average 12-month target price of $267.76, showing 86.6% upside from current price, with stock rising due to Anthropic IPO listing impact.
fields.summary_ko.1: With Anthropic as SpaceX's largest customer representing over one-third of Q3 revenue, successful IPO at $83/share validates SpaceX's AI business expansion beyond space operations, and Citi raised target price from $240 to $280 following successful Starship 15th test.
